g.title: Step1
g.text: User uploads manuscript; triggers async ingestion

g.title: Editors
g.text: Rich text and code diff visualization

g.title: VercelBlob
g.text: Persists raw PDF, Word, and Image files

g.title: RLHF
g.text: Stores human feedback to tune agent logic

g.title: Step2
g.text: Interviews user & extracts target journal constraints

g.title: Step3
g.text: Drafts high-level revision strategy & identifies flaws

g.title: Step5
g.text: Extracts visual charts and verifies raw statistics

g.title: Step7
g.text: Synthesizes reviews and generates final Rebuttal

g.title: Step8
g.text: Rewrites text in standard academic tone (removes AI style)

g.title: Step9
g.text: Applies line-by-line Diff changes to the manuscript

g.title: Step10
g.text: Final checks: Plagiarism, references, & formatting rules

g.title: Step11
g.text: Packages final Word/PDF and Cover Letter for user
